Apple has updated the Apple Store app's privacy policy with terms related to an upcoming virtual shopping assistant. Details below.

Apple is expanding its use of artificial intelligence in its retail operations

According to MacRumors, a new section titled "Virtual Shopping Assistant" has been added to the Apple Store app and its privacy page, with content as follows:

In other words, the Apple Store app may soon introduce chatbot functionality that delivers personalised responses based on user data and assists users in making purchasing decisions.

Apple says that personally identifiable information will be stripped from conversations before they are shared with an unnamed partner to generate assistant responses, suggesting that the experience is likely powered at least in part by a third-party company's model.

Chat history will be kept within the app for users to review, while Apple will also store it for business analytics. Users can choose whether to allow their conversation content to be used to improve the virtual shopping assistant through a new "Chat Improvements" setting.

Judging from the wording of Apple's privacy policy, the virtual assistant may initially launch only in selected countries and regions, and is highly likely to debut in English-speaking markets first before gradually expanding to more languages and regions.

This announcement comes months after Apple added an AI chatbot to its Sales Coach app, which provides sales and technical support resources for Apple retail partners. Employees can access the chatbot via the "Ask" tab, where the system answers questions based on official Apple training materials and documentation.

In addition, Bloomberg previously reported that Apple has been testing a system called "Live Notes" in select retail stores, which uses AI to record, transcribe and summarise conversations during Genius Bar sessions, allowing employees to focus on serving customers without being distracted by taking notes.

For more information about the Apple Store app and its privacy policy, please visit the link below.
